Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source activities and compound_structures. Join activities to compound_structures on activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter by assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613918' and activities.standard_value is not null and activities.standard_relation = '='. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
